svg.aria-label: The Tiffin Grab mark built as a four-tier steel tiffin on a bamboo mat: jeera rice, tur dal, palak paneer and rotis in green tiers under a marigold lid with an orange knob. Behind it, a prep board with dal and rice cooking on a two-burner gas stove and a masala dabba of seven spices; The tiffin stands on a steel thali, a jar of achar on the board, a steel tumbler of water, katoris of boondi raita and kachumber salad and the mark's orange spoon in front; at the back, a desk calendar whose day columns light for the delivery days. At the end the tiffin is latched, steaming, ready for delivery.
